training_source: SER training on CREMA-D, ESD, MELD, M3ED and Singaporean speech; retained Whisper-medium pretraining sources are incompletely disclosed; upstream seed/base teacher use is counted as seen

columns.audio_path: audio file, relative to the emotion_recognition/ folder
columns.acted_emotion: ground truth: the emotion each actor was asked to portray, from the third number in the file name (01 neutral, 02 calm, 03 happy, 04 sad, 05 angry, 06 fearful, 07 disgust, 08 surprised)
columns.prediction: model prediction: the most probable of the 7 emotions evaluated (neutral, happy, sad, angry, fearful, disgusted, surprised)
columns.prediction_all_classes: model prediction: the most probable of all 7 model classes
columns.p_*: model probability of each of its 7 classes (they add up to 1)

training_reason: SER report documents emotion2vec seed/base teachers for SG-ECMT labels; their EmoBox corpus subset is unresolved. This counts as upstream training use; it does not assert direct reuse of those raw clips by MERaLiON.
